svg.title: Personal Agents OS: the knowledge graph model
svg.desc: Each node is a markdown file with frontmatter wikilinks written as forward and reverse pairs. Fake example: the owner Alex meets Sam at Café Example in Lisbon.
svg.text: PERSONAL AGENTS OS · 2 / 4 · THE KNOWLEDGE GRAPH
One node, one markdown file. Links live in frontmatter.
Every edge is a quoted [[slug]] wikilink, written as a forward + reverse pair. Fake example: Alex (the owner) meets Sam at Café Example.
point of view: the owner's day with Sam
# Sam Rivera (profile, in Sam's own words)
regulars: the reverse edge, written by lint.py --fix
body, food, training days, lab reports
who writes links: remember-people (the skill) → tools/graph.py forward edge → lint.py --fix reverse edge
Body prose links are free-form and are not edges. The contract is LEGEND.md; the memory model is anatomy.md.
